public.title: Gas Station
public.description: Stations form a clockwise cycle. At station i add gas[i] and spend cost[i] to reach the next station, starting with an empty tank. Return the smallest starting index that permits a full circuit, or -1 if none does. Both arrays have equal length from 1 to 500, with entries from 0 to 1000.
hints: If a candidate fails at a station, every intermediate candidate also fails.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Track the running surplus and restart after a negative prefix. Total surplus determines feasibility; the first surviving candidate is the smallest valid start. O(n) time.
